'''2018 European Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee European match-play championship, 17 February 2018. [[Kevin Jaap]] is published first on the results list.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Europe
* '''Dates:''' 17 February 2018
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Jaap]]
